messages:
Rina: Heads-up: fp8 experiment on gpt-small-v4 shows a localized accuracy regression on 'tables+ids' slice (~1.1% drop). Rolling back further promotion pending triage.
Omar: Can you share a couple of failing examples? is it mis-ordering or missing tokens?
Rina: Samples: 
- 'Extract invoice IDs and amounts from table' -> missed one amount
- 'Map user handles to ids' -> swapped two adjacent ids occasionally
Kai: That pattern smells like attention numeric sensitivity + small-head instability in fp8. perf-bot: kernel traces show slightly higher quantization noise in q/k matmul for long rows.
Isha: Ops wants a minimal workflow: quick slice-level shadowing, a one-click pause, and clear canary thresholds so oncall can act.
Omar: Proposal: build a small "quant-slice" spec teams include in rollouts: model, profile, slices (runtime filter), min_samples, thresholds, shadow_rate, diag_level.
Kai: Example: 
quant-slice-spec:
  model: gpt-small-v4
  profile: fp8-v3
  slices:
    - name: tables_ids
      filter: "token_count>70 and numeric_token_count>2"
  min_samples: 200
  quality_delta_pct: 0.5
  shadow_rate: 0.3
  diag_level: low
Isha: UI ask: in Console surface slice cards with quick-sample toggle and a prominent 'hold/rollback' CTA. Also show pctl drops and sample counts.
Rina: Runtime safety: if a slice breaches quality threshold for 10m, route that slice to fallback profile (fp8->int8-mixed) automatically. Must be opt-out per-customer.
Omar: Telemetry suggestions: sampled per-head activation mean/std, small sign-flip counters, and percent-identical-output vs baseline. Keep default sampling tiny to limit cost.
perf-bot: Note: enabling per-head histograms increases CPU usage when active; advise timeboxed collection.
Kai: Follow-ups: Omar spec for quant-slice (ETA 4d), Isha Console card prototype (ETA 3d), Rina run targeted A/B and provide logs (ETA 12h), perf will add lightweight diag counters (ETA 5d).
Rina: Ops paused promotion at 30% and ramped slice shadowing to 0.5 for 1h. Will post A/B outcomes here.
sentry-bot: Canary alert recorded at 02:10 UTC; investigation ticket created #INC-8121.
Isha: Good discussion. Keep manifests simple at first; iterate after we see actual signal quality.
